lastCompletedAction: R1 remediation package, FROZEN AND UNACCEPTED at migration 0083. Two independent adversarial reviews, both CHANGES REQUESTED, both correction loops used. Review 1 found 14 findings including a scheduled drain that re-dispatched every retried message as '[object Object]' and a retry that duplicated the drafted payment; review 2 found 9 more, including a P0 my own loop-1 fix introduced — the pipeline was made idempotent but not resumable, so every second execution dead-lettered and left a captured payment in awaiting_approval with no approval request. All 23 are fixed. Review 2 also corrected this program's own claim: the duplicate-detection harness bug was TEST-ONLY and detection was never dead in production; that claim is withdrawn. OF-014 was assessed as directed — forging the JWT-role GUC does NOT generally grant service-role access because EXECUTE grants are the real gate, but _quotation_status_for_guard combined PUBLIC EXECUTE with a permissive claim branch and leaked a quotation status to anon; anon and PUBLIC lost EXECUTE, while the predicate itself could not be replaced (the function is SECURITY DEFINER so current_user is the owner, and session_user under PostgREST is authenticator, which Supabase grants service_role membership — trying it broke a fail-closed control). Evidence closure then found OF-016, a MATERIAL BLOCKER: a suspected duplicate has no resolution RPC, no screen and no write grant, so a real payment can pause reversibly with nothing able to move it again.
